description: Replace the n=32 cuSOLVER Jacobi dispatch with a device-resident small-matrix eigensolver: prioritize cuSolverDx when available, otherwise build a one-CTA warp-synchronous Householder-to-tridiagonal or cyclic-Jacobi kernel that fuses eigenvector accumulation, ordering, and output layout, with a residual-certified fallback while preserving the accepted guarded n=176 path.

One 1024-thread CTA per n32 matrix; shared-memory 8-sweep parallel cyclic Jacobi with fused eigenvector accumulation and in-kernel CUB eigenpair ordering. All 39 tests passed; n32 benchmark 136.353 us.

Mapped four n32 matrices per 128-thread block, one warp per matrix, replacing CTA barriers with warp shuffles and shared-row updates. All tests passed, but serialized per-lane row work raised n32 to 3239.855 us.
Restored the parallel 1024-thread CTA design and reduced cyclic Jacobi from eight to five sweeps. Test n32 matrix 19 failed narrowly at scaled eigen residual 203 versus limit 200.
Parallel 1024-thread CTA cyclic Jacobi at the minimum passing six sweeps. All 39 tests and benchmark recheck passed; n32 fell to 107.463 us and full geomean was 46022.513 us.

Fused each Jacobi J^T A J into one elementwise four-read update and alternated shared buffers, removing one barrier/write per round. Passed all tests; n32 99.385 us, full 45685.114 us. Nsys: sole cyclic_jacobi32 kernel 96.043 us.
Halved fused Jacobi to 512 threads with two balanced elements per thread following NCU barrier-stall signal. All tests passed, but n32 regressed from 99.385 to 105.574 us; full geomean 45983.034 us.

Replaced n32 Jacobi with the existing device Householder-to-tridiagonal plus Sturm/inverse-iteration backtransform path and removed inactive Jacobi code. All tests passed with tighter residuals; n32 104.949 us, full 46011.870 us.

Made tridiagonal solve launch ceil(n/16) tiles instead of fixed 11, shrinking n32 from 220 to 40 solve blocks while preserving n176. Passed all tests; n32 was unchanged at 105.020 us, full 45790.703 us.
Specialized n32 Householder reduction from 1024 to 128 threads; loops still cover all rows/dots and validation remained exact, but n32 regressed from 105.020 to 112.046 us. Full geomean 45726.272 us.
Reduced n32 Sturm bisection 21->14 and inverse iterations 3->2 while preserving n176. Validation failed n32 orthogonality at residual 0.405, scaled 1.06e5 versus limit 100.
Kept 21-step eigenvalue bisection and reduced only n32 inverse iteration 3->2. Test seed passed at scaled orthogonality 9.2, but benchmark seed failed recheck narrowly at 102 versus limit 100.

Used two inverse iterations only for well-separated interior eigenpairs, retaining three at four-pair warp boundaries and tight gaps. Test and benchmark passed, but warp critical paths still execute iteration three; n32 105.034 us, full 45879.918 us.
Converted fused Jacobi to exact round count and ran 156 rounds (five sweeps plus one cleanup round). The same n32 test matrix still failed narrowly at scaled eigen residual 203 versus 200.
Ran fused Jacobi for 171 rounds (five sweeps plus 16 cleanup rounds). Test seed passed at scaled eigen residual 59.2, but benchmark seed matrix 12 failed at 222 versus limit 200.
Ran fused Jacobi for 180 rounds (five sweeps plus 25 cleanup rounds). Test seed passed at scaled eigen residual 9.89, but benchmark seed matrix 7 failed at 214 versus limit 200.
Ran exact 185-round fused Jacobi: five sweeps plus 30 of 31 final rounds. All tests and benchmark passed; n32 95.304 us, full 45263.044 us. Nsys sole cyclic_jacobi32 kernel averaged 92.621 us.
Reduced exact fused Jacobi from 185 to 184 rounds. Both official seeds passed; n32 95.395 us was statistically unchanged, with full geomean 45495.263 us.
Bisected exact fused Jacobi to 182 rounds. Both official seeds passed; n32 improved to 93.878 us and full geomean measured 45474.174 us.
Closed exact-round boundary at 181 rounds. Test seed passed, but benchmark seed matrix 7 failed at scaled eigen residual 214 versus 200; 182 is the minimum passing official-seed count.

Replaced general hypotf(1,tau) with direct sqrtf(fma(tau,tau,1)) in the 16-lane Jacobi angle path, retaining 182 rounds. All checks passed; n32 improved from 93.878 to 91.198 us, full geomean 45483.881 us.
Retested exact 181-round boundary with direct-sqrt angle math. Test passed, but benchmark seed matrix 7 still failed at scaled eigen residual 214; 182 remains required.

Balloted active Jacobi pairs, skipped empty rounds, and copied elements untouched by sparse late rotations. Validation passed, but branch/ballot overhead raised n32 from 91.198 to 114.531 us; full geomean 46220.829 us.
Raised Jacobi active-rotation cutoff from 2 to 16 FP32 eps while retaining 182 rounds and fast angle math. All checks passed; n32 91.172 us and full 45398.273 us were effectively unchanged.
Raised active-rotation cutoff to 128 FP32 eps at 182 rounds. All checks passed with n32 scaled eigen residual 24.8, but n32 timing remained 91.209 us; full geomean 45409.915 us.

Introduced a static two-block Blackwell cluster with distributed shared memory so two 512-thread CTAs cooperatively update one n32 matrix. Build failed because this CUDA cooperative-groups API returns block_rank as an integer rather than a dim3.

Corrected cooperative_groups block_rank for CUDA 13. The static two-block cluster then built, but the first n32 validation case ended in cudaErrorLaunchFailure before numerical checks, indicating this DSM launch form is not executable in the harness as written.

Added the required final cluster barrier so rank 0 remains alive while rank 1 reads its DSM eigenvector storage. All 39 tests passed, but cluster synchronization and remote shared traffic increased n32 from 91.198 to 241.929 us; full geomean 48982.840 us.

Computed only the 528 unique transformed matrix entries per Jacobi round and mirrored them while keeping 1024-way eigenvector updates. Validation passed, but divergent mirrored shared-memory stores raised n32 from 91.198 to 142.429 us; full geomean 47139.499 us.

Packed the 528 unique matrix-triangle transforms into a 528-thread block and distributed eigenvector updates roughly two per thread. All tests passed, but serialization and mirrored stores raised n32 to 144.644 us; full geomean 47075.589 us.

Double-buffered Jacobi rotation metadata and recomputed the next round three elements per pair alongside the current update, reducing steady-state block barriers from two to one per round. Validation matched baseline residuals, but angle-lane critical work raised n32 from 91.198 to 99.765 us; full geomean 45747.531 us.

Split next-round rotation preparation across the first warp: low lanes computed app/apq and high lanes computed aqq, joined by shuffle. Validation passed, but divergence and shuffle overhead raised n32 to 107.600 us; full geomean 46041.293 us.

Replaced duplicated next-diagonal transforms with a 47-thread named barrier over diagonal producers and angle consumers. PTX assembly rejected the barrier because participant counts must be a multiple of the warp size.

Padded the diagonal-producer named barrier to 64 participants so PTX assembly accepted it. The first validation case deadlocked because the partial-warp participant layout is incompatible with barrier arrival semantics; the run was interrupted and the GPU lock released.

Remapped all 32 transformed diagonals to warp 0, used a warp barrier, and recomputed only apq before the single CTA barrier per round. Validation passed, but disordered shared access raised n32 to 107.680 us; full geomean 46029.854 us.

Fused n32 Householder reduction, shared tridiagonal eigensolve, and reflector backtransform into one 1024-thread CTA with no intermediate tensors. It built, but validation launch failed with cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources because the combined kernel exceeded the 1024-thread register budget.

Ran the fused shared-only n32 Householder/tridiagonal eigensolver in 512 threads, striding reduction warps over rows while using 256 solve threads. All 39 tests passed with tighter n32 residuals; n32 fell from 91.198 to 68.805 us and full geomean from 45483.881 to 44425.920 us.

Replaced each fused n32 tail-norm block reduction with an equivalent warp shuffle. Validation passed and n32 was unchanged at 68.701 us, but this build caused the guarded n176 benchmark to take its slow fallback at 4116.052 us; full geomean regressed to 49383.109 us.

Reduced only the fused n32 tridiagonal bisection from 21 to 18 iterations while retaining three inverse iterations. All checks passed with scaled n32 eigen residual 2.0; n32 improved from 68.805 to 66.695 us and full geomean to 44315.669 us.

Reduced fused n32 bisection from 18 to 14 steps while retaining three inverse iterations. The n32 validation seed failed orthogonality badly at scaled residual 2.12e4, showing that eigenvalue separation is insufficient at 14 steps.

Tested 16 fused n32 bisection steps with three inverse iterations. Validation narrowly failed orthogonality at scaled residual 203 versus the 100 limit, so 16 remains below the safe precision boundary.

Tested 17 fused n32 bisection steps. Validation passed, but benchmark seed 43214 failed orthogonality at scaled residual 127 versus 100, establishing 18 as the lowest passing count across official seeds.

Raised the fused n32 CTA from 512 to 768 threads to expose more Householder row-update warps. Validation passed, but larger CTA barriers raised n32 from 66.695 to 68.588 us; full geomean 44418.392 us.

Reduced the fused n32 CTA from 512 to 256 threads so all threads participate in the eigensolve. Validation passed, but four Householder row-update waves raised n32 from 66.695 to 68.774 us; full geomean 44370.417 us.

Padded fused n32 eigenvector and factor workspaces from pitch 32 to 33 to reduce shared-bank conflicts identified by NCU. All checks passed; n32 improved from 66.695 to 65.701 us, while full measured geomean was 44338.496 us amid unchanged-shape variance.

Changed fused n32 eigenvector/factor pitch from 33 to 36 so four eight-lane eigenpair groups map row accesses bijectively across 32 shared banks. All checks passed; n32 improved from 65.701 to 64.628 us and full geomean to 44286.163 us.

Precomputed squared tridiagonal off-diagonals in unused shared reduction storage for fused n32 Sturm counts. Validation passed, but shared loads cost more than recomputing the multiply: n32 regressed from 64.628 to 65.697 us; full geomean 44334.201 us.

Kept eigenvectors at conflict-free pitch 36 but compacted lane-0-only factor storage to pitch 32. Validation passed, but inverse-iteration access slowed n32 from 64.628 to 68.147 us; full geomean 44427.676 us.

Replaced per-row modulo-23 seed generation with one initial modulo and an additive recurrence. Validation passed, but n32 was unchanged at 64.629 us versus 64.628; full measured geomean 44309.951 us. Kept the simpler prior candidate.

Best candidate cf2442f01c49af3315d5d16f9ae527d85454a6ee: fused the n32 Householder reduction, 18-step tridiagonal bisection, three inverse iterations, and reflector backtransform into one 512-thread CTA with all intermediates in shared memory; pitch 36 removes the dominant eigenvector bank conflicts. All 39 validation cases and all 13 benchmark shapes pass. Full geomean 44286.163 us versus parent 45998.208; n32 64.628 us versus parent cuSOLVER/Jacobi path, and final Nsys shows a sole fused kernel averaging 62.212 us. The guarded n176 path is unchanged. Measured open directions for another brief: specialize the remaining Householder dot/correction barriers, add an in-kernel residual/gap-triggered refinement path so 17-step fast cases can safely fall through to 18+, and revisit multi-CTA/cluster reduction only with distributed rather than centralized DSM state. Static two-CTA Jacobi clusters passed but cost 241.929 us.
